# Repository Discoverability Optimization (RDO) Matrix

<!-- last-verified: 2026-08-29 -->

Optimization taxonomy for GitHub search indexing, repository topics, and SEO.

---

## 1. Topic Taxonomy Guidelines

Every repository must contain between **6 to 12 curated topics**:

1. **Ecosystem & Brand**: `tidyfactor`, `ai-agents`
2. **Platform & Agent Targets**: `antigravity`, `claude-code`, `cursor`, `codex`
3. **Core Domain**: `github-actions`, `repository-governance`, `devops`, `readme-engine`
4. **Primary Tech Stack**: `typescript`, `python`, `node`

---

## 2. Repository Description Optimization

- **Length**: 80 to 120 characters maximum.
- **Formula**: `[Brand/Tool Name] — [Primary Capability/Verb] [Target Domain] on [Stack/Platform]`.
- **Example**: `TidyFactor GitHub — GitHub Platform Operations, Governance, Content, Experience & Intelligence Engine for AI Coding Agents`.
- **Homepage URL**: Always link to live documentation portal or umbrella ecosystem page.
